title: M6 — Signal-first long-running supervisor (DOT-style)
description: Build the DOT/Grokbot-style loop: signals as front door, Mastra supervisor workflow for triage and delegation, long-running process supervision, research branch, and plantool-backed proposals for new skills/workflows. Builds on MAST-54-58 and docs/mastra-signals.md.
why: MVP workers and intake exist; the product goal is a persistent companion that routes all input through Signals and decides delegation via workflow rather than prompt luck.

acceptance.text: Every user and worker event enters through the intake ledger
Long runs survive restart via reconcile and task or durable resume
User can inspect failed intake and background work
